content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: gpu-rendezvous - collective timeout detected on cluster tp4-cluster (severity: P1). Paging oncall: @sanjay_oncall. Root TS: 2969999999

emma_dev: seeing sustained NCCL timeouts / hang on inference pods serving tp4-7b. Affected pod: inference-tp4-7b-0 on gpu-node-12. Requests are queuing, latencies spiking to >30s and then 504s.

ashley_sre: +1 i see the same from tracing. Collective operations stall around allreduce start. No obvious OOM in the container logs.

emma_dev: attaching recent stderr from container (truncated):

```
[2026-03-15 10:02:14] NCCL INFO AllGather start
[2026-03-15 10:02:15] NCCL WARN timeout at 30000ms
[2026-03-15 10:02:15] NCCL ERROR communicator aborted, ret=2
[2026-03-15 10:02:15] TensorParallel: rendezvous failed
```

maria_prod: seeing customer-facing 504 spikes for ~3% of hosted API traffic to tp4-7b; most requests are retried or routed, but a subset from region us-west2 got dropped. Customer impact = degraded throughput and intermittent errors.

sanjay_oncall: acknowledged, I'm on it. Jumping to bridge now. Can someone run `nvidia-smi -q` + `kubectl describe pod inference-tp4-7b-0` and paste results? We'll need to check GPU health and container OOMs.

leo_infra: running checks now. Preliminary `nvidia-smi` shows GPU3 with ECC errors incrementing, dmesg contains a GPU fault (Xid 63). No CUDA OOM messages in container logs yet.

ashley_sre: dmesg excerpt ->

```
[ 12345.678901] NVRM: Xid (0001:0063) Ecc error on GPU 3
[ 12345.679002] NVRM: GPU 0000:65:00.0: Xid 63: Gpu has fallen off the bus.
```

emma_dev: interesting — that explains the communicator aborts. When one rank drop happens in NCCL it can block the whole collective.

opsbot: created incident bridge: https://calls.example/bridge/abc123 — assigned owner: @sanjay_oncall — Pager group: gpu-rendezvous.

sanjay_oncall: immediate mitigation plan: (1) drain node gpu-node-12 from serving pool, (2) route traffic for affected model to fallback single-gpu variant (tp4-7b-solo) and reduce batch size to 1, (3) restart inference pod after env toggles to enable async error handling and collect core.

maria_prod: applying routing change now — shifting 100% of tp4-7b traffic away from gpu-node-12 to fallback pool. Will monitor error budget.

ashley_sre: commands I'm running:

```bash
# mark node unschedulable for serving pods
kubectl cordon gpu-node-12
# evict serving pods (graceful)
kubectl drain gpu-node-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
# restart the problematic container with NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING=1 to allow failure propagation
kubectl set env pod/inference-tp4-7b-0 NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING=1 NCCL_DEBUG=INFO
kubectl delete pod inference-tp4-7b-0
```

leo_infra: collecting `/var/log/messages`, `dmesg`, and `nvidia-bug-report.sh` for postmortem. Also ran `nvidia-smi -q -d ECC` and captured ECC counters.

emma_dev: while draining, we saw a second communicator reset; logs show the pod attempted fallback but hung on rendezvous with rank 2. Looks like the hardware fault caused an unclean disconnect.

derek_eng: for visibility — this is happening during TokenService batches using TP4 pipeline parallel with split ranks across two nodes. When one rank died, other ranks waited without timeout until NCCL forced an abort. We should consider shorter NCCL timeout or per-request fast-fail on our side.

sanjay_oncall: agreed. Short-term: routing to single-gpu variant reduced error rate from ~3% to ~0.2% within 90s. Customers are recovering. Next: replace node from pool and run hardware diagnostics. Long-term: add automatic fallback to non-collective path when NCCL aborts detected.

maria_prod: I notified top 5 affected customers via the status page and opened a post-incident ticket for SRE & Hardware. Status page updated: "Degraded - partial outage for tp4-7b in us-west2. Mitigation applied: traffic routed to fallback model; remaining impacts minimal."

emma_dev: note for collection: please capture the container core dump (we have coredump collection enabled on nodes). If not present, enable `SECURE_CORE=1` and `ulimit -c unlimited` before restarting. Also gather `/proc/<pid>/stack` if process still hung.

ashley_sre: we found a core at /var/crash/core.inference-1234. Uploading to S3 now: s3://redwood-crashes/gpu-node-12/inference-tp4-7b/core-1234.tar.gz

leo_infra: hardware follow-up: GPU3 shows persistent ECC correctable/injectable failures. We flagged node for replacement and kicked off a support ticket with cloud provider.

sanjay_oncall: handoff plan — I'm keeping command-owner for the incident until the immediate mitigation window ends (next 30m). Then I'll hand to @leo_infra for hardware RMA and long-term fix. @derek_eng please start a small RFC on fallback non-collective path and NCCL timeout tuning.

derek_eng: will do. Early notes for RFC: add per-request deadline enforcement in the TP orchestration layer, expose NCCL param `NCCL_SOCKET_TIMEOUT` for aggressive failfast in production, and a canary rollout for fallback path.

maria_prod: Customer comms: posted note to status and emailed SLAs group. No escalations to enterprise customers yet — we offered targeted mitigation for customers with strict SLOs.

emma_dev: quick checklist for postmortem capture (saved here):
- core dumps: s3 path above
- nvidia-smi logs and ECC counters (collected)
- pod manifests and env (captured via `kubectl get pod -o yaml`)
- traces showing request ids that failed (collected by tracing)
- kernel dmesg (collected)

opsbot: incident updated: severity->P1 -> mitigated (customer impact reduced). Bridge: https://calls.example/bridge/abc123

sanjay_oncall: wrapping: routing mitigation held, node cordoned & drained, core collected, hardware ticket created, post-incident action items assigned. I'll open the incident postmortem doc and assign owners: Leo (hardware RMA), Derek (fallback RFC), Ashley (playbook updates), Emma (traces + regression tests).

ashley_sre: adding immediate playbook note: when Xid 6* or 63 seen -> cordon node, route to fallback, enable `NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING=1`, collect core, and escalate to infra. Will PR in runbooks repo. :thumbsup:

maria_prod: closing customer-impact loop: notify affected customers with RCA draft once infra confirms RMA timeline.

sanjay_oncall: handing off to @leo_infra for hardware follow-up (oncall window ends in 25m). If anything changes, reactivate pager. Great job team. :white_check_mark:

leo_infra: taking post-incident owner. Will follow up in the postmortem thread with hardware logs and RMA ticket id.

incident-bot: Incident transition: owner set to leo_infra, state=postmortem_pending, incident_id=INC-20260315-42.

(End of thread)
